items.exampleEn: My brother and I had a fight.
Please fill the glass with water.
Push the door to open it.
I save some money every month.
I missed the bus this morning.
items.exampleZh: 我今天早上錯過了公車。

items.sentenceEn: Please do not fight with your brother.

items.audioEn: Come on! We will miss the train.
items.audioZh: 快點！我們會趕不上火車。

items.sentenceEn: Don't push. Please wait in line.
I dropped my phone on the floor.

items.stemEn: I don't buy coffee. I want to ____ money for a trip.
items.stemZh: 我不買咖啡，我想存錢去旅行。

items.stemEn: I can't ____ on my homework. My brother is playing music.
items.stemZh: 我沒辦法專心寫功課，我弟弟在放音樂。

items.passageEn: This morning was bad. I missed the bus, so I walked to work. At the office, I dropped my coffee on the clean floor. Then I had a fight with my friend about a small thing. In the evening, I listened to music and felt better. I must focus on the good things.
items.passageZh: 今天早上很糟。我錯過了公車，只好走路上班。到了辦公室，我把咖啡打翻在乾淨的地板上。接著我又為了一件小事和朋友吵架。晚上我聽了音樂，覺得好多了。我要專注在好的事情上。

questions.questionZh: 說話者為什麼走路上班？
晚上說話者做什麼讓自己好過一點？

items.promptZh: 可以幫我把杯子倒滿嗎？
referenceEn: Can you fill my cup, please?
rubricZh: 「把⋯倒滿」可用 fill＋容器（例如 fill my cup；寫 fill my cup with tea、fill up my cup 也正確）
請求可用 Can you…?、Could you…?、Please… 等

items.instructionZh: 用 miss 造一個句子，說說你錯過或想念的人事物。
referenceEn: I miss my family in Tainan.
rubricZh: miss 可表示「錯過」（例如 miss the bus）或「想念」（例如 miss my family）
過去的事用過去式（例如 missed）
